name: Abyssal storage: deposit and withdraw materials, keep bound materials out of the account vault
contract: With mod-abyssal-storage-plus at its defaults (AbyssalStoragePlus.Enable=1), .asp deposit moves every
storable trade good from the bags into the account-wide vault and .asp withdraw returns it. Items added by
the harness have no loot source, so they stay in the bags until the deposit. Primal Nether (23572) binds
on pickup; the account-wide vault would hand it to other characters, so neither the deposit of everything
nor a targeted .asp deposit takes it, while unbound Linen Cloth (2589) moves. After a relog the deposit is
still in the vault and not back in the bags. The addon's interface is not exercised; this checks the

steps.label: CONTROL: items without a loot source stay in the bags
Deposit of everything leaves the bound Primal Nether in the bags
A targeted deposit refuses the bound Primal Nether
After a relog the deposited cloth is not back in the bags
